versions.changelog: Add agent Setup: free signup, 500 credits, fetcher key creation, and REPLYNODES_API_KEY instructions.
Switch to prepaid credits with one long-lived fetcher key; remove legacy payment paths.
Move x402 accountless access information to the beginning of the description.

- Removed 13 files related to "appstore-api", including documentation, licenses, references, and tests.
- No changes to YouTube functionality or API endpoints.
- Cleaned up repository by eliminating unrelated or sample files.

youtube-public-api 1.0.4 introduces expanded documentation, x402 support evidence, and modular examples.

- Major documentation rewrite: SKILL.md now details x402 pay-per-request (USDC on Base), dual authorization modes, and normalized output examples for every endpoint.
- Expanded endpoint examples and schemas: Each public operation (search, video, channel, comments, playlist, related, transcript) now includes JSON response examples and required/optional params.
- Highlights the availability and limits of x402, clarifying negotiation vs. settlement and account-free operation.
- Adds modular appstore-api/ directory with references, evidence, and documentation for external publication/integration.
- Improved metadata, examples, and security notes to clarify read-only, public-data access and error reporting.
Retry server-resolvable public GitHub provenance with the immutable source SHA as both commit and ref for ClawHub card generation.
Publish with server-resolvable public GitHub provenance for generated ClawHub skill-card verification; align package metadata at 1.0.2.
Add required ClawHub skill-card.md and retain the seven-route read-only x402 contract.
Initial neutral release: seven read-only YouTube routes and truthful x402 v2 negotiation docs.
